purpose: Characterize existing historical CA checkpoints and inference interventions; hypothesis screening only, not matched training ablation or independent generalization evaluation.

selection.algorithm: sort cities/files; one NumPy default_rng; choose 3 indices without replacement per city; sort chosen indices within city
selection.smoke: first 3 of the same fixed manifest, in a separate output

interventions.definition: unchanged trained CA output x*a_vertical*a_horizontal; checked against unwrapped model
return x; changes magnitude and patterns; not equivalent to a separately trained model without CA
x*mean(g), g=a_vertical*a_horizontal; removes channel and spatial patterns
x*mean_hw(g) per channel; removes spatial patterns
x*L2(original_CA_output)_hw/L2(x)_hw per channel; removes spatial patterns while preserving per-channel output feature energy
permute H and W axis maps using seed42 plus stable sample-id hash; preserve gate value distributions
shuffle42 followed by per-channel scaling to original CA output L2 energy
shuffle43 followed by per-channel scaling to original CA output L2 energy
x*((1-0.1)+0.1*g); inference stress test only, not a trained mixed-gate candidate

gate_statistics.statistics_units: per-image channel/pixel gate values; aggregate by image, not pooled unequal feature resolutions
gate_statistics.spatial_display: mean_channels(a_vertical*a_horizontal), fixed color scale 0..1; never product of separately averaged axes
gate_statistics.regional_masks: foreground/background and author foreground boundary; area downsample to feature grid, fractional occupancy weights

metrics.global: sum confusion over fixed selected images, compute foreground IoU and mIoU
metrics.boundary: author foreground Boundary IoU, per-image mean; both-empty excluded with count
metrics.paired_differences: within checkpoint and image, intervention minus original; report positive/negative/unchanged counts
metrics.historical_references: separate trained ENet/SBNet weights, observational only
metrics.validation: none in this stage; train samples are diagnostics, not an independent test

interpretation: A gate below 1 necessarily attenuates features algebraically; this alone is not a failure mechanism.
Interventions may shift the trained decoder or BN input distribution even after energy matching.
Shuffle sensitivity supports reliance on learned positions within the checkpoint; it does not prove improved training or universal directional reasoning.
Fixed train-set sample results cannot replace full validation or repeated matched training.
No automatic decision to implement/train mixed-gate candidates solely from this stage.
